description: This file defines interfaces and data structures for handling object files in a version control system, including functionalities for loose object storage, reading and writing objects, verifying object signatures, and managing object cache.

classes.name: odb_source_loose
classes.description: Structure representing a loose object source, including cache and mapping for stored objects.

methods.name: odb_source_loose_new
methods.description: Creates and initializes a new loose object source.

methods.name: odb_source_loose_free
methods.description: Frees resources associated with a loose object source.

methods.name: odb_source_loose_reprepare
methods.description: Resets the loose object cache, preparing the source for fresh scanning.

methods.name: odb_source_loose_read_object_info
methods.description: Reads object metadata from the loose database.

methods.name: odb_source_loose_read_object_stream
methods.description: Reads an object as a stream from the loose database.

methods.name: odb_source_loose_has_object
methods.description: Checks whether a loose object with a given ID exists.

methods.name: odb_source_loose_freshen_object
methods.description: Updates or refreshes the state of a loose object.

methods.name: odb_source_loose_write_object
methods.description: Writes a new loose object directly to the database.

methods.name: odb_source_loose_write_stream
methods.description: Streams data into a loose object.

methods.name: odb_source_loose_cache
methods.description: Returns the cache of loose objects for a given object ID.

methods.name: odb_loose_path
methods.description: Determines the filename for storing a loose object based on its ID.

methods.name: for_each_loose_file_in_source
methods.description: Iterates over loose files, invoking callbacks for each.

methods.name: for_each_loose_object
methods.description: Visits all loose objects without reachability filtering.

methods.name: format_object_header
methods.description: Formats the object header for a loose object.

methods.name: force_object_loose
methods.description: Ensures an object is stored loose, updating its timestamp.

methods.name: check_object_signature
methods.description: Verifies that the object data matches its expected signature.

methods.name: stream_object_signature
methods.description: Verifies object signature using streaming.

methods.name: finalize_object_file
methods.description: Finalizes writing an object file atomically.

methods.name: hash_object_file
methods.description: Computes the hash of an object file based on its contents.

methods.name: check_and_freshen_file
methods.description: Checks and updates the modification time of a file.

methods.name: read_loose_object
methods.description: Reads a loose object from disk and verifies its signature.

methods.name: object_file_transaction_begin
methods.description: Begins a transaction for batch object insertion.

methods.name: object_file_transaction_commit
methods.description: Commits a batch of objects written in a transaction.

ctags.name: each_loose_cruft_fn
ctags.typeref: typename:int ()(const char * basename,const char * path,void * data)

ctags.name: each_loose_object_fn
ctags.typeref: typename:int ()(const struct object_id * oid,const char * path,void * data)

ctags.name: each_loose_subdir_fn
ctags.typeref: typename:int ()(unsigned int nr,const char * path,void * data)
